parsed.note_claim: Mitch McConnell is alive and his office stated as of July 2, 2026 that he continues to improve in the hospital and is working with his staff.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: "Senator McConnell appreciates the outpouring of support he's receiving while he continues his recovery in the hospital. The Senator continues to improve, and is working closely with his staff on Kentucky and Senate matters while the Senate is out of session."
parsed.reason: The TMZ page directly quotes McConnell's spokesperson confirming he is alive, still hospitalized, continuing to improve, and working with staff as of July 2, 2026.
